let _now = now() - 5h;
officeCam
| where ts >= startofday(_now) 
    and ts <= _now
    and event_type == "PERSON_ENTERED"
| summarize TotalFootfall = count()

let _now = now() - 5h;
let _today_str = format_datetime(startofday(_now), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
StoreRevenue
| where rev_date == _today_str
    and rev_hour <= datetime_part("hour", _now)
| summarize 
    TodaysRevenue = round(sum(revenue), 2),
    TodaysRevenueDisplay = strcat("$", tostring(round(sum(revenue), 2)))

let _now = now() - 5h;
officeCam
| where ts >= _now - 24h and ts <= _now
| summarize
    Entries = countif(event_type == "PERSON_ENTERED"),
    Exits = countif(event_type == "PERSON_EXITED")
    by bin(ts, 15m)
| order by ts asc

let _now = now() - 5h;
officeCam
| where ts >= _now - 7d and ts <= _now and event_type == "PERSON_ENTERED"
| extend DayOfWeek = case(
    dayofweek(ts) == time(0:00:00), "0-Sun",
    dayofweek(ts) == time(1.00:00:00), "1-Mon",
    dayofweek(ts) == time(2.00:00:00), "2-Tue",
    dayofweek(ts) == time(3.00:00:00), "3-Wed",
    dayofweek(ts) == time(4.00:00:00), "4-Thu",
    dayofweek(ts) == time(5.00:00:00), "5-Fri",
    "6-Sat")
| extend Hour = tostring(datetime_part("hour", ts))
| summarize Visitors = count() by DayOfWeek, Hour
| order by DayOfWeek asc, Hour asc
